tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List workspaces by page. Local filesystem paths are omitted.

tools.name: agentboard_list_workspaces
tools.description: List workspaces by page. Local filesystem paths are omitted.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List flat tasks or one cursor-paginated level of the task tree in one effective workspace. Listings omit task descriptions (description, description_truncated, next_description_offset_chars are absent to keep responses small); call get_task to read one task with its description.

tools.name: agentboard_list_tasks
tools.description: List flat tasks or one cursor-paginated level of the task tree in one effective workspace. Listings omit task descriptions (description, description_truncated, next_description_offset_chars are absent to keep responses small); call get_task to read one task with its description.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Read one task including a description window from one effective workspace. list_tasks omits descriptions, so use this tool for a task body.

tools.name: agentboard_get_task
tools.description: Read one task including a description window from one effective workspace. list_tasks omits descriptions, so use this tool for a task body.

tools.name: get_task_comments
tools.description: Read a paged comment list without advancing the shared unread cursor.

tools.name: agentboard_get_task_comments
tools.description: Read a paged comment list without advancing the shared unread cursor.

tools.name: get_task_comment
tools.description: Read a comment body window without changing comment read state.

tools.name: agentboard_get_task_comment
tools.description: Read a comment body window without changing comment read state.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a task in one effective workspace.

tools.name: agentboard_create_task
tools.description: Create a task in one effective workspace.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Update task fields with the expected task timestamp.

tools.name: agentboard_update_task
tools.description: Update task fields with the expected task timestamp.

tools.name: claim_task
tools.description: Atomically claim an eligible task; the configured agent ID is an audit label.

tools.name: agentboard_claim_task
tools.description: Atomically claim an eligible task; the configured agent ID is an audit label.

tools.name: release_task
tools.description: Release a task owned by the configured agent.

tools.name: agentboard_release_task
tools.description: Release a task owned by the configured agent.

tools.name: add_task_comment
tools.description: Add a task comment under the configured agent audit label.

tools.name: agentboard_add_task_comment
tools.description: Add a task comment under the configured agent audit label.

tools.name: complete_task
tools.description: Complete a task owned by the configured agent.

tools.name: agentboard_complete_task
tools.description: Complete a task owned by the configured agent.

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description: Permanently delete a task. Irreversible; rejected while the task is claimed or when it still has child tasks.

tools.name: agentboard_delete_task
tools.description: Permanently delete a task. Irreversible; rejected while the task is claimed or when it still has child tasks.

tools.name: fail_task
tools.description: Return a task to planning with a required failure reason.

tools.name: agentboard_fail_task
tools.description: Return a task to planning with a required failure reason.

tools.name: close_task
tools.description: Close a task that is in review (待验收). Rejected while the task is claimed or while any descendant task is still open.

tools.name: agentboard_close_task
tools.description: Close a task that is in review (待验收). Rejected while the task is claimed or while any descendant task is still open.

tools.name: reopen_task
tools.description: Reopen a closed or deprecated task into the given workspace status (default 待规划). Rejected while the task is claimed.

tools.name: agentboard_reopen_task
tools.description: Reopen a closed or deprecated task into the given workspace status (default 待规划). Rejected while the task is claimed.

tools.name: accept_task
tools.description: Record a structured acceptance verdict on a task waiting for review (待验收). Writes a 【验收记录】 comment; it does not change the task status.

tools.name: agentboard_accept_task
tools.description: Record a structured acceptance verdict on a task waiting for review (待验收). Writes a 【验收记录】 comment; it does not change the task status.

tools.name: list_dependencies
tools.description: List a task's blockers and blocked tasks in one effective workspace, with the server-side resolved flag.

tools.name: agentboard_list_dependencies
tools.description: List a task's blockers and blocked tasks in one effective workspace, with the server-side resolved flag.

tools.name: add_dependency
tools.description: Add a blocker edge: the blocked task cannot be claimed until the blocker is resolved (acceptance or closed).

tools.name: agentboard_add_dependency
tools.description: Add a blocker edge: the blocked task cannot be claimed until the blocker is resolved (acceptance or closed).

tools.name: remove_dependency
tools.description: Remove a blocker edge from a task.

tools.name: agentboard_remove_dependency
tools.description: Remove a blocker edge from a task.

tools.name: list_statuses
tools.description: List one workspace's status dictionary (name, kind, sort order, builtin flag).

tools.name: agentboard_list_statuses
tools.description: List one workspace's status dictionary (name, kind, sort order, builtin flag).

tools.name: add_status
tools.description: Add a custom status to one workspace. Builtin statuses cannot be duplicated (409); kind drives behaviour.

tools.name: agentboard_add_status
tools.description: Add a custom status to one workspace. Builtin statuses cannot be duplicated (409); kind drives behaviour.

tools.name: remove_status
tools.description: Remove a custom status. migrate_to is required: tasks in that status are moved to it in the same transaction. Builtin statuses are rejected.

tools.name: agentboard_remove_status
tools.description: Remove a custom status. migrate_to is required: tasks in that status are moved to it in the same transaction. Builtin statuses are rejected.

tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: Search knowledge in common, one workspace, or that workspace plus common.

tools.name: agentboard_search_knowledge
tools.description: Search knowledge in common, one workspace, or that workspace plus common.

tools.name: list_knowledge
tools.description: List knowledge pages as bounded metadata summaries (no body) in common, one workspace, or that workspace plus common.

tools.name: agentboard_list_knowledge
tools.description: List knowledge pages as bounded metadata summaries (no body) in common, one workspace, or that workspace plus common.

tools.name: find_knowledge_sources
tools.description: Find knowledge pages whose current sources reference a file path, content hash, or source id.

tools.name: agentboard_find_knowledge_sources
tools.description: Find knowledge pages whose current sources reference a file path, content hash, or source id.

tools.name: read_knowledge
tools.description: Read one knowledge page with codepoint windows, paged sources/evidence, and optional paged history.

tools.name: agentboard_read_knowledge
tools.description: Read one knowledge page with codepoint windows, paged sources/evidence, and optional paged history.

tools.name: create_knowledge
tools.description: Create a knowledge page in the explicitly selected scope.

tools.name: agentboard_create_knowledge
tools.description: Create a knowledge page in the explicitly selected scope.

tools.name: revise_knowledge
tools.description: Revise a knowledge page using expected_revision compare-and-swap.

tools.name: agentboard_revise_knowledge
tools.description: Revise a knowledge page using expected_revision compare-and-swap.

tools.name: archive_knowledge
tools.description: Archive a knowledge page using expected_revision compare-and-swap.

tools.name: agentboard_archive_knowledge
tools.description: Archive a knowledge page using expected_revision compare-and-swap.

tools.name: restore_knowledge
tools.description: Restore a knowledge page using expected_revision compare-and-swap.

tools.name: agentboard_restore_knowledge
tools.description: Restore a knowledge page using expected_revision compare-and-swap.

tools.name: list_decisions
tools.description: List pending decisions in one workspace with state/issue filters and counts. Use get_decision for full context and answer revisions.

tools.name: agentboard_list_decisions
tools.description: List pending decisions in one workspace with state/issue filters and counts. Use get_decision for full context and answer revisions.

tools.name: get_decision
tools.description: Read one decision with options, answer revisions, checkpoint and remaining grace. Text fields are windowed.

tools.name: agentboard_get_decision
tools.description: Read one decision with options, answer revisions, checkpoint and remaining grace. Text fields are windowed.

tools.name: stop_check
tools.description: Check whether the agent was asked to stop on a task. Read-only; it does not acknowledge the stop signal.

tools.name: agentboard_stop_check
tools.description: Check whether the agent was asked to stop on a task. Read-only; it does not acknowledge the stop signal.

tools.name: ask_decision
tools.description: Create a pending decision (ask the user) on a running task owned by the configured agent. Does not wait for an answer; revisit with get_decision or stop_check. grace_seconds=0 locks immediately.

tools.name: agentboard_ask_decision
tools.description: Create a pending decision (ask the user) on a running task owned by the configured agent. Does not wait for an answer; revisit with get_decision or stop_check. grace_seconds=0 locks immediately.

tools.name: answer_decision
tools.description: Answer a pending decision as the human operator (option ordinal or label, or free text). Revising an existing answer requires expected_revision (CAS). Server rejects non-human answered_by.

tools.name: agentboard_answer_decision
tools.description: Answer a pending decision as the human operator (option ordinal or label, or free text). Revising an existing answer requires expected_revision (CAS). Server rejects non-human answered_by.

tools.name: extend_decision_grace
tools.description: Extend the grace window of a decision that is still in grace. 1-300 seconds per call; original grace plus extensions cannot exceed 600 seconds. Not available after the decision locks.

tools.name: agentboard_extend_decision_grace
tools.description: Extend the grace window of a decision that is still in grace. 1-300 seconds per call; original grace plus extensions cannot exceed 600 seconds. Not available after the decision locks.

tools.name: withdraw_decision
tools.description: Withdraw a pending decision with a required reason. The audit actor defaults to AGENTBOARD_AGENT_ID; the workspace owner permission is granted by the local server identity.

tools.name: agentboard_withdraw_decision
tools.description: Withdraw a pending decision with a required reason. The audit actor defaults to AGENTBOARD_AGENT_ID; the workspace owner permission is granted by the local server identity.

tools.name: list_changelog
tools.description: List workspace change-log entries (newest first). Each entry carries title/type/actor/revision and a 300-character body preview; use get_changelog for the full body.

tools.name: agentboard_list_changelog
tools.description: List workspace change-log entries (newest first). Each entry carries title/type/actor/revision and a 300-character body preview; use get_changelog for the full body.

tools.name: get_changelog
tools.description: Read one change-log entry, including the body windowed at 12000 characters (continuation offset returned when truncated).

tools.name: agentboard_get_changelog
tools.description: Read one change-log entry, including the body windowed at 12000 characters (continuation offset returned when truncated).

tools.name: create_changelog
tools.description: Append a workspace change-log entry (title + body_md + change_type 新增/修复/调整). Required before marking a task done; request_id is the idempotency key.

tools.name: agentboard_create_changelog
tools.description: Append a workspace change-log entry (title + body_md + change_type 新增/修复/调整). Required before marking a task done; request_id is the idempotency key.
